title: Cross-language hashing (RFC 8785)
one_line: Hashes Python, TypeScript and Rust compute identically, floats included.
verified_against: RFC 8785 text (rfc-editor.org, read 2026-11-22): Appendix B numbers and section 3.2.3/3.2.4 examples pinned; cyberphone/json-canonicalization testdata (6 files, fetched 2026-11-22) pinned; Python and Rust number formatting compared with V8 String(x) in Node.js 22.23.5 on 599,872 random doubles with 0 mismatches. 78 shared vectors asserted by Python, TypeScript (vitest) and Rust (cargo test). No third-party JCS library was run.
